title: docs: add Vercel AI SDK guide
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds a Vercel AI SDK section to the API docs: `@ai-sdk/openai-compatible` for text, streaming, images and embeddings
- Switches the README snippet to the same provider and links the full section
- Verified every snippet against `gen.pollinations.ai` with `ai@7.0.118` and `@ai-sdk/openai-compatible@3.0.57`
- Prerequisite for requesting a listing on ai-sdk.dev's OpenAI-compatible providers page

Replaces quest #15530.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

gist.headline: Four paths, one provider
gist.blurb: The Vercel AI SDK now has its own trail through the API docs. Text, streams, images, and embeddings all have working examples; Polli left the breadcrumbs in the README.
gist.summary: Added Vercel AI SDK examples using @ai-sdk/openai-compatible for text, streaming, images, and embeddings, and updated the README to link the guide; every snippet was verified against gen.pollinations.ai with ai@7.0.118 and @ai-sdk/openai-compatible@3.0.57.
gist.impact: Developers using the Vercel AI SDK can copy verified @ai-sdk/openai-compatible examples for all four tasks instead of working out the provider setup from scratch.
